audience: Young Israelis taking advice from parents and friends; aspiring entrepreneurs; the podcast's listeners.

story.setup: I believed what you believe: school, good grades, a degree, a good job.
story.stakes: Parents' advice leads to the average income, which he says is near the poverty line.
story.progression: Education path, then the 'what now' question, then the infographic (average ₪7,500 and poverty line ₪3,800 per month), then 'when everyone does the same, the result is the first insight', then you become the people around you.
story.payoff: Two rules: (#1) doubt everything about money or success from non-successful people, (#2) find better role models who earn more.
story.payoff_delivered: partly: two rules are given late (after 60 s) and the first claim of the opening is not reached until about 36 s
